images.quarantine_reason: Stale image bytes inherit nvcr.io/nvidia/isaac-lab and bake NVIDIA driver libraries; an EULA runtime flag cannot make those bytes publicly redistributable.
images.name: npa-sonic
images.purpose: Self-contained SONIC runtime for compute-only VM hosts that do not mount NVIDIA graphics userspace.

gpu_compatibility.why: The host does not provide the graphics userspace Isaac Lab needs, so the image carries the matching NVIDIA GL, NVML, and Vulkan libraries.

build.command: disabled: quarantined bytes must not be rebuilt or pushed

images.name: npa-sonic
images.purpose: SONIC runtime for GPU-operator-managed Kubernetes nodes where the NVIDIA host driver is mounted into the container.

gpu_compatibility.provider_model: Nebius Managed Kubernetes with NVIDIA GPU Operator
gpu_compatibility.why: The GPU Operator mounts driver-matched NVML, GL, and Vulkan userspace from the node, so the image must not carry conflicting driver-coupled libraries.
Use the CUDA 13 sm_120 PyTorch base, the operator-mounted driver stack, and NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES=all.

build.command: official releases use .github/workflows/publish-public-images.yml; build.sh is BYOF-only

images.quarantine_reason: Stale image bytes inherit the quarantined npa-sonic:0.1.2 image and its restricted baked NVIDIA payload.
images.name: npa-sonic-mujoco
images.purpose: Combined SONIC fine-tuning and MuJoCo evaluation runtime for the first G1 MVP milestone.

gpu_compatibility.why: The SONIC release fine-tune path is state/proprioceptive and headless; MuJoCo eval uses EGL/headless physics and does not require RT-core rendering.
Capacity fallback for the same headless state-based workload when H100 spot capacity is unavailable.

build.command: disabled: quarantined bytes must not be rebuilt or pushed
additional_packages: inherited public parent EGL/GL runtime libraries

images.name: npa-sonic-mujoco
images.purpose: Public SONIC runtime plus pinned headless MuJoCo evaluation, with Isaac retained as operator-consented runtime fetch only.
images.headless_geometry: Upstream dynamics with primitive collision proxies when public checkout mesh paths are Git-LFS pointers; no LFS asset is baked.

gpu_compatibility.provider_model: Nebius GPU node with host driver injection
gpu_compatibility.why: The exact PyTorch CUDA 12.8 wheel closure supports Blackwell; MuJoCo uses EGL/headless physics without Omniverse or RT-core rendering.

gpu_compatibility.provider_model: Nebius Kubernetes with NVIDIA GPU Operator
gpu_compatibility.why: The exact PyTorch CUDA 12.8 wheel closure supports sm_120 and receives driver userspace from the host rather than baking it.

build.command: gh workflow run publish-public-images.yml --ref <prepared-branch> -f development_sha=<full-git-sha> -f build_development_tools=sonic-mujoco -f dry_run=true
additional_packages: redistributable CUDA Toolkit runtime libraries under their included NVIDIA SDK terms

validation.capability: real Unitree G1 SONIC MuJoCo rollout
validation.result: 64 finite simulation steps; fall rate 0; metrics artifact verified
validation.payload: filesystem, layer, history, Omniverse, secret, SBOM, vulnerability, and provenance gates passed

workload_note: workloads is the set of SONIC pipeline stages a variant can serve, using the npa.workbench.sonic.routing identifiers. gpu_selection maps a GPU target to a variant, so resolution must intersect the two: sonic-mujoco-runtime-fetch is the only variant that matches a B200 target and it serves mujoco-eval only, which means a finetune or train request on B200 has no published image and must fail rather than silently resolve the evaluation runtime.
